from.place: Proof sentence 1 ('The equivariant lifts of the operations ... are [lem-fix-weil-operations]'), at the passage of the Frobenius pullback comparisons to algebraically closed coefficients: the inverse Frobenius transport and the pullback comparison P_X Lf^* = Lf^* P_Y must be natural in the common-stage category, which needs their compatibility with the pullback scalar-extension comparisons.

title: Pullback composition and inverse identities commute with integral scalar extension
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and finite extensions $E\subset L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, with valuation rings $\mathcal O_E\subset\mathcal O_L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $W$ on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] and $F\in\{E,L\}$ let $D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_F)$ be the derived-complete integral constructible category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], and let $T_W:D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)	o D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_L)$, $K\mapsto K\otimes_{\mathcal O_E}\mathcal O_L$, be integral scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. For a morphism $f:W'	o W$ of such schemes let $Lf_F^*$ be the integral derived pullback over $\mathcal O_F$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and let $\alpha^f_K:T_{W'}(Lf_E^*K)\xrightarrow{\sim}Lf_L^*(T_WK)$, for $K\in D^b_c(W,\mathcal O_E)$, be the natural scalar-extension comparison of [lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension].

1. *Composition.* Let $h:Z	o W$ and $k:W	o V$ be morphisms of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible, and let $c^{\mathcal O_F}_{h,k}:L(k\circ h)_F^*\xrightarrow{\sim}Lh_F^*Lk_F^*$ be the integral composition isomorphisms of [lem-pod-integral-pullback-composition]. Then for every $K\in D^b_c(V,\mathcal O_E)$
$$Lh_L^*(\alpha^k_K)\circ\alpha^h_{Lk_E^*K}\circ T_Z igl(c^{\mathcal O_E}_{h,k}(K) igr)=c^{\mathcal O_L}_{h,k}(T_VK)\circ\alpha^{k\circ h}_K$$
as isomorphisms $T_Z(L(k\circ h)_E^*K)	o Lh_L^*Lk_L^*(T_VK)$.

2. *Inverse identities along an isomorphism.* Let $g:X	o Y$ be an isomorphism of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible, with inverse $ ar g:Y	o X$, and write $g^{-1}, ar g^{-1}$ for the inverse-image functors on pro-etale module sheaves [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. For $F\in\{E,L\}$ and $K\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_F)$ let $\lambda^g_K:Lg_F^*K\xrightarrow{\sim}g^{-1}K$ and $\lambda^{ ar g}$ be the isomorphisms of [lem-weil-isomorphism-derived-pullback], and let
$$\epsilon^F_K:L ar g_F^*Lg_F^*K\xrightarrow{\ \lambda^{ ar g}_{Lg_F^*K}\ } ar g^{-1}Lg_F^*K\xrightarrow{\  ar g^{-1}(\lambda^g_K)\ } ar g^{-1}g^{-1}K\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }K,$$
the last arrow being the canonical isomorphism of inverse images along $g\circ ar g=\mathrm{id}_Y$ [lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image]. Then for every $K\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$
$$\epsilon^L_{T_YK}\circ L ar g_L^*(\alpha^g_K)\circ\alpha^{ ar g}_{Lg_E^*K}=T_Y(\epsilon^E_K)$$
as isomorphisms $T_Y(L ar g_E^*Lg_E^*K)	o T_YK$.

source.place: First paragraph: 'Pullback uses g_X^*f^*=f^*g_Y^*' and the inverse automorphism squares, read at the algebraically closed level of def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, where an arrow over a common finite field acts through the scalar-extension comparisons of lem-pur-integral-operations-scalar-extension; the blueprint leaves the compatibility of these comparisons with the composition and inverse identifications implicit.
